review: [N Corp. E.G.O::Fell Bullet] Yi Sang is an interesting Poise-centric Identity who utilizes an effect called “Torn Memory” - which was previously used only in a certain E.G.O. This shines the most when a plan and team is made in mind before the fight, as his most damaging skill requires killing an Ally for the ideal outcome. “Torn Memory” is a resource that is spent by Yi Sang’s Skill 3 and it is gained in a small amount from his Skill 1 & Skill 2 second Coins as well as his Defensive skill. If Yi Sang scores a Critical Hit on Skill 1 and Skill 2, “Torn Memory” gain will be increased. To start off, he has 2 Combat Passives. The First Passive is for maintaining Torn Memory, which would otherwise fade away at the end of the Turn, preventing it from stacking.
